description: Cykelvägnät med grundegenskaper is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Trafikverket. Contains a series of basic data on the cycling road network taken from a variety of existing data products. Coverage: Trafikverket. The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle road network with basic characteristics" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Trafikverket. Its keywords include NVDB. The listing shows 2024-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
